description: Navigation traffic-light surface drawn. Traffic-light guidance renders when navigation is active and traffic data is present. sta_Navi becomes NAVI_ON via DI_AEC_Navigation_Status (diAEControl.cpp:351) when val_power==POWER_ON(3) and val_naviStatus in {2,3}; the traffic-light content comes from the cross-light signal First_Cross_light_status_S (0x43F, 2.2-2.4, DiDCGetFirstcrosslightstatusS / First_Cross_light_status_S_CallBack). Show modeled with active navigation, display out of simple mode, and a known cross-light value.

mem.desc: POWER_ON, required by DI_AEC_Navigation_Status for NAVI_ON
